description: Use this when the user wants printable math cage puzzles (arithmetic cage puzzles, calculation sudoku-style grids with cages, math logic puzzles for a class) as a PDF with an answer key. Each grid from 4 x 4 to 9 x 9 uses the numbers 1 to N once per row and column; each cage shows a target and a sign. Put one object per puzzle in puzzles[] when they differ (size, operations, difficulty); for a set of the same kind, set count with size, operations and difficulty. Operations accept signs or words ("+ -", "add only", "all four", "no division"). A solver checks each puzzle for one solution. The PDF has 1, 2 or 4 puzzles per page on Letter or A4, an optional title and name line, and answer pages. Defaults: 1 medium 6 x 6 puzzle with all four operations, Letter, 1 per page, name line and answer key on. Does not solve a puzzle from a photo or make grids larger than 9 x 9.

answer_key.description: Add answer pages with the solved grids (default true). Example: true

count.description: How many puzzles when they are all the same kind (1 to 12, default 1). Example: 4

difficulty.description: Difficulty for all puzzles: easy, medium (default) or hard. Example: easy

name_line.description: Print a Name and Date line on the puzzle pages (default true). Example: false

operations.description: Signs for all puzzles: + - x / (default all four), or words such as "addition and subtraction only", "no division". Example: "+ x"

paper.description: letter (default, US 8.5 x 11 in) or a4. Example: a4

per_page.description: Puzzles per printed page: 1 (default), 2 or 4. Example: 2

difficulty.description: easy, medium (default) or hard. Harder puzzles have bigger cages and fewer single-number cells. Example: hard

operations.description: Signs the cages may use: "+", "-", "x", "/", words such as "add only", "all four", "no division", or a list. Example: "+ -"

seed.description: Seed for this puzzle (same seed and settings give the same puzzle). Example: 4821

size.description: Grid size from 4 to 9 (4 means 4 x 4 with the numbers 1 to 4). Example: 6

puzzles.description: One object per puzzle when the puzzles differ, e.g. [{"size":4,"operations":"add only"},{"size":6,"difficulty":"hard"}]. Leave out and use count for a set of the same kind. Up to 12.

seed.description: Starting seed; puzzle N uses seed + N - 1. Reuse it to reprint the same puzzles. Example: 2026

size.description: Grid size for all puzzles, 4 to 9 (default 6). Example: 5

title.description: Title printed at the top of each page. Example: Friday Math Challenge

name: generate_math_cages
title: Generate math cage puzzles
